note: REQ-125 ruling B, same-day. K1 a co-taught class is cancelled as before (the split never fires) · K2 D4 «cannot» falls through to the cancel · K3 the LAST teacher's class is left alone (listed) instead of cancelled · K4 the split keys always ride the answer (a sole-teacher answer changes shape) · K5 one coach entry per class instead of one per coach per day · K6 promotedTo never reported · K7 `cancelled` counts every live target · K8 «continues with» names empty. K9 a continuing class counted as cancelled · K10 the families of a continuing class told.

mutations.what: 🔴 a co-taught class is cancelled exactly as before — the split never fires (the REQ-125 defect)
🔴 D4: a class nobody can take over falls through to the cancel
🔴 the LAST teacher's class is left alone (listed) instead of cancelled
the split keys always ride the answer — a sole-teacher leave answers with a different shape
one coach entry per CLASS instead of one per coach per day (the LINE would repeat)
`cancelled` counts every live target, including the ones that continue

edits.from: return { cancelled: cancelledIds.length, bookingIds: cancelledIds, familiesNotified, ...split };
edits.to: return { cancelled: live.length, bookingIds: cancelledIds, familiesNotified, ...split };

mutations.what: 🔴 condition 3: a CONTINUING class is counted as cancelled (its id joins `bookingIds`, `cancelled` grows)

edits.from: continues.push(await describeContinuation(tx, b, me, out, coachNotices));
edits.to: cancelledIds.push(b.id); continues.push(await describeContinuation(tx, b, me, out, coachNotices));

mutations.what: 🔴 condition 4: the FAMILY of a continuing class is told (the cancel notice for a class that is still on)

edits.from: continues.push(await describeContinuation(tx, b, me, out, coachNotices));
edits.to: familiesNotified += await sendClassCancelledToFamilies(tx, b as any, "TEACHER_LEAVE", []); continues.push(await describeContinuation(tx, b, me, out, coachNotices));
